notes.title: Open World Survival Crafting Fest + Demo Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, Misty Islands is honored to participate in this year's " Open World Survival Crafting Fest." Our demo has been updated to version [b]0.04[/b]. We hope you enjoy it.

[h2]Update v0.04[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added new boss: Spider Queen
[*] Added turret-type facilities
[*] Increased frequency of monster attacks at night
[*] Improved lighting effects
[*] Fixed many bugs
[/list]

The game is still in the process of development, If you have any problems / BUG report/ gameplay suggestions, please feel free to leave them on our [url=https://discord.gg/gDQ97A2j9q]Discord[/url].

notes.title: Misty Islands -- Lunar New Year Festival+ Version 0.0.4 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hello everyone！

Misty Islands is now participating in the Lunar New Year Festival 2024. Hope you can enjoy our Playtest Demo!

Additionally, based on your feedback, we have updated the playtest with the following details:
[h2]Update:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Reduced the materials required for most crafting.
[*]Lowered the hint frequency.
[*]Added classification labels to the synthesis system.
[*]Fixed a bug where some equipment's additional skills were not triggering.
[*]Resolved issues with some placed objects being either too difficult or too easy to break.
[*]Game pause when the Esc menu is opened.
[*]Opened the first phase of the third island, featuring a heavily guarded pirate camp gate.
[/list]

If you have any problems / BUG report/ gameplay suggestions, please feel free to leave them on our [url=https://discord.gg/gDQ97A2j9q]Discord[/url].

Game version: 0.0.4

notes.title: Misty Islands - Version 0.0.3 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone!

Since the release of the public demo, we've received a lot of feedback from players, and we're excited to bring you this update.

Here are the changes:
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where placing torches caused a loss of vision after loading a save.
[*]Fixed a bug where monsters that had already respawned wouldn't move after loading a save.
[*]Maximum stamina now decreases more slowly.
[*]Hunger points now decrease more slowly.
[*]Lowered the number of materials required for crafting certain items.
[/list]

Misty Islands now has a limited-time public demo available. If you have any problems / BUG report/ gameplay suggestions, please feel free to leave them on our [url=https://discord.gg/gDQ97A2j9q]Discord[/url].

Test time: 10. 27 - 11.5
Game version: 0.0.3

notes.title: Steam Scream Festival + Limited-Time Public Demo
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone!

We are delighted to announce that Misty Islands is now participating in Steam Scream Fest, and a limited-time public demo will be available for playing from October 27th to November 5th!

[b]The Latest Update: [/b]
[list]
[*]Fix several known bugs
[*]Implement a new explorable island, with new resoureces, new monsters and a new Boss
[*]Implement tooltips for some items
[*]Improving UI action rules
[*]improving some animation effects
[*]Monsters will no longer chase the player when they are out of action range.
[/list]

The Alpha Test 0.02 for Misty Islands is now open! The game is still in the earliest stages of development, and there are many unfinished parts. If you have any problems / BUG report/ gameplay suggestions, please feel free to leave them on our [url=https://discord.gg/gDQ97A2j9q]Discord[/url].

Test time: 10. 27 - 11.5
Game version: 0.0.2

notes.title: Misty Islands - The First Trailer Released!
notes.notes:
The action survival adventure game developed by SleepyValley Studios and published by Hawthorn Games, Misty Islands, has released the first trailer today!

Resource collection, home building, equipment crafting, and island exploration. Survive on a deserted island with limited resources and uncover the secrets beyond the mist!
